Edisa Redzic
UniVie Doctoral School Computer Science (DoCS)
The UniVie Doctoral School Computer Science (DoCS) offers a framework to support young researchers through collaboration across the University and beyond. While completing the doctoral programme we aim to connect people, offer funding and provide ideal conditions for our members to focus on working with their colleagues to create meaningful research impact. We also keep you informed about news and events related to the Doctoral Programme and the Doctoral School.
